about: A tool that automates file management with simple rules.

prs.title: The lowercase extensions rule leaves files without one alone
prs.broken: The documented rule for making file extensions lowercase also matched files with no extension, so a file like LICENSE was renamed with a stray dot at the end.
prs.changed: The extension filter with no list now matches only files that have an extension.
prs.matters: People who copy the example rule from the docs no longer get broken file names.

prs.title: Two documentation examples work as written
prs.broken: One example rule failed on every file with an error, and the keep-folder-structure examples put each file inside a folder named after itself.
prs.changed: Both examples are corrected and give the documented results.
prs.matters: People who copy rules from the docs get working renames and moves.

prs.title: The duplicate finder catches copies it used to miss
prs.broken: When an unrelated file of the same size and with the same start was seen first, real copies of a later file were not reported as duplicates.
prs.changed: Each file's fingerprint is now remembered even when it has no match yet, so later copies find it.
prs.matters: Cleaning up duplicate scans or images no longer leaves copies behind.
